{{Short description|Turkish household appliances manufacturer}} {{Use dmy dates|date=April 2023}} {{Infobox company | name = Arçelik A.Ş. | type = [[Public company|Public]] | logo = Arçelik logo.svg | logo_size = 250px | traded_as = {{IMKB|ARCLK}} | genre = [[Electronics]] | founded = {{start date and age|df=yes|1955}} | founder = [[Vehbi Koç]] | hq_location = [[Sütlüce, Beyoğlu]], Istanbul, Turkey | area_served = Worldwide | key_people = [[Rahmi Koç]] ([[chairman]])
[[Hakan Bulgurlu]] ([[CEO]]){{cite web |url=https://www.arcelikglobal.com/media/6798/arcelik21_faaliyet_raporu.pdf |title=Annual Report 2021 |publisher=Arçelik A.Ş. |access-date=4 June 2021}} | industry = [[Consumer electronics]], [[Home appliance]]s | products = [[Television set|TV sets]], [[refrigerator]]s, [[washing machine]]s, [[vacuum cleaner]]s, [[air conditioner]]s, [[DVD player]]s, [[Blu-ray|Blu-ray players]], [[Home cinema|home cinema systems]], [[movie projector]]s, [[laptop]]s, [[Optical disc drive|CD and DVD drives]], [[computer monitor]]s, [[Charging station|EV chargers]] | revenue = {{Increase}} [[US$]]13.28 billion (2024){{cite web |url=https://www.arcelikglobal.com/media/fq4nk2rw/2024-earnings-presentation.pdf |title=Annual Report 2024 |publisher=Arçelik A.Ş.}} | operating_income = {{decrease}} US$206 million (2024) | net_income = {{decrease}} US$49 million (2024) | assets = {{decrease}} US$11.52 billion (2024) | equity = {{Increase}} US$2.17 billion (2024) | num_employees = about 55,000 {{cite web |url=https://www.arcelikglobal.com/media/fq4nk2rw/2023-earnings-presentation.pdf |title=Annual Report 2023 |publisher=Arçelik A.Ş.}} | parent = [[Koç Holding]] | website = {{URL|https://www.arcelikglobal.com}} }} '''Arçelik A.Ş.''' ({{IPA|tr|aɾtʃeˈlic}}) is a Turkish multinational [[household appliances]] manufacturer. The company engages in the production, marketing and after-sale services of durable goods and their components. Its products include white goods (such as refrigerators, freezers, washing machines, dishwashers) and small home appliances (such as vacuum cleaners, coffee makers and blenders). Arçelik A.Ş. is active in more than 100 countries, including [[China]] and the [[United States]] through its 13 international subsidiaries and over 4,500 branches in [[Turkey]]. The company operates 15 production plants in [[Turkey]], [[Romania]], [[Russia]], [[China]], [[South Africa]] and [[Thailand]] including refrigerator, washing machine, dishwasher, cooking appliances and components plants.{{cite web|url=http://www.arcelikas.com/UserFiles/file/160202_FACTSHEET_TR_Q415.pdf|title=Factsheet|website=Arçelik AŞ|access-date=11 April 2023|archive-date=20 December 2016|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161220072034/http://www.arcelikas.com/UserFiles/file/160202_FACTSHEET_TR_Q415.pdf|url-status=dead}} It offers products under its own brand names, including Arçelik, [[Beko]], [[Grundig]], [[Dawlance]], Altus, Blomberg, [[Arctic S.A.|Arctic]], [[Defy Appliances|Defy]], Leisure, Arstil, Elektra Bregenz and Flavel.{{Cite web|url=http://www.arcelikas.com/page/80/Brands|title=Arçelik A.Ş.: Brands|access-date=11 April 2023|archive-date=23 October 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201023075047/http://www.arcelikas.com/page/80/Brands|url-status=dead}}{{Cite web|url=http://www.arcelikas.com/sayfa/72/Arcelik_Kurumsal_Tanitim|title=Arçelik A.Ş.: Corporate Overview|access-date=11 April 2023|archive-date=6 August 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200806014339/http://www.arcelikas.com/sayfa/72/Arcelik_Kurumsal_Tanitim|url-status=dead}} The company is controlled by [[Koç Holding]], Turkey's largest industrial and services group with USD 24.9 billion in consolidated revenues in the first half of 2023,{{Cite web |title=Koç Holding {{!}} Koç Holding Sustains Its Successful Performance Through the First Half of 2023 |url=https://www.koc.com.tr/media-center/latest-news/2023/koc-holding-announced-its-financial-results-for-the-first-half-of-2023 |access-date=2024-01-30 |website=www.koc.com.tr}} and is the market leader in Turkey's appliance sector with its Arçelik and Beko brands. Following the merger of European activities with [[Whirlpool Corporation]], Beko Europe became the largest household appliances company in Europe, ahead of [[BSH Hausgeräte]] and [[Electrolux]] based on production volumes.{{Cite web |title=Arçelik |url=https://www.arcelikglobal.com/en/company/press-room/press-releases/arcelik-launches-beko-europe-a-leading-provider-of-sustainable-home-appliances-in-europe/ |access-date=2024-05-10 |website=www.arcelikglobal.com |language=en}} It has been reported that as of April 2024, the company will continue its activities in the global market under the name [[Beko Corporate]].{{Cite web |date=2024-04-05 |title=İş Bankası, Koç Holding hamlesiyle tüm şirketlerin birleşeceğini duyurdu |url=https://abcgazetesi.com/is-bankasi-koc-holding-hamlesiyle-tum-sirketlerin-birlesecegini-duyurdu-736430 |access-date=2024-04-07 |website=ABC Haber |language=tr}}{{Cite web |last=Mynet |title=Arçelik, küresel operasyonlarını Beko adı altında sürdürecek |url=https://finans.mynet.com/haber/detay/ekonomi/arcelik-kuresel-operasyonlarini-beko-adi-altinda-surdurecek/480441/ |access-date=2024-04-07 |website=Mynet Finans |language=tr}} == History == [[File:Atatürk Kültür Merkezi, Aluminium Facade, İstanbul (12966548755).jpg|thumb|right|200px|Istanbul Atatürk Cultural Center construction of the aluminium facade, 1960s.]] Source:{{Cite web |title=Arçelik |url=https://www.arcelikglobal.com/en/company/about-us/history/ |access-date=2023-08-14 |website=www.arcelikglobal.com |language=tr}} Arçelik A.Ş. was founded in 1955 by Lütfü Doruk in partnership with [[Vehbi Koç]] operating in the Turkish home appliances industry. Arçelik produced its first washing machine in 1959 and its first refrigerator in 1960 at its manufacturing plant in Çayırova, Istanbul. In 1986, Arçelik A.Ş. went public on [[Borsa Istanbul]]. In 1999, Arçelik and [[LG Electronics]] founded the joint-venture Arçelik-LG Klima Sanayi ve Ticaret A.Ş. for manufacturing air conditioning units for the Turkish and global markets.{{Cite web |title=Arçelik {{!}} LG - |url=https://www.arcelik-lg.com.tr/ |access-date=2023-08-14 |website=Arçelik {{!}} LG |language=tr-TR}} In 2006, [[Koç Holding]] decided to merge their subsidiaries in the home appliances industry under the roof of Arçelik A.Ş. These companies included the Atılım ve Gelişim Pazarlama A.Ş. which marketed Arçelik branded products, [[Beko|Beko Elektronik A.Ş.]] which marketed Beko branded products and Türk Elektrik Endüstrisi A.Ş. which produced engines and compressors for Arçelik and Beko branded products. The new organization model enabled the company to manage production and sales/marketing activities centrally and to increase productivity.{{Cite web |date=1999-11-03 |title=Koç şirketleri global rekabete karşı birleşti |url=https://www.milliyet.com.tr/ekonomi/koc-sirketleri-global-rekabete-karsi-birlesti-5234642 |access-date=2023-08-14 |website=Milliyet |language=tr}} Arçelik A.Ş. made a series of acquisitions to grow its global presence: Blomberg (2002), Elektra Bregenz (2002), Leisure (2002), Flavel (2002), Arctic (2002), Grundig (2007), Defy (2011), Dawlance (2017), Singer (2019). It also partnered with other multinationals to form alliances: [[Tata Group]] in India, [[Hitachi]] in several Asia-Pacific markets and [[Whirlpool Corporation]] in several European markets. ==Global presence== In a bid to become a leading appliance manufacturer with a global presence, Arçelik has pursued both organic and inorganic growth. Arçelik is recognized in most markets by its [[Beko]] brand, while its portfolio also contains smaller local brands. '''EMEA Region''' In 2002, Arçelik made a series of acquisitions to grow its presence in the EMEA region: German and Austrian operations of [[Brandt (brand)|Groupè Brandt]] which owned Blomberg and Elektra Bregenz brands, UK-based Leisure and Flavel brands and Romanian appliance maker [[Arctic S.A.]]{{Cite web |title=Arçelik iki yeni şirket satın aldı |url=http://arsiv.ntv.com.tr/news/151059.asp |access-date=2023-08-14 |website=arsiv.ntv.com.tr}}{{Cite web |title=Alman Blomberg artık Arçelikin... - Son Haberler - Milliyet |url=https://www.milliyet.com.tr/ekonomi/alman-blomberg-artik-arcelikin-349072 |access-date=2023-08-14 |website=www.milliyet.com.tr}}{{Cite web |title=Arçelik, İngiliz markası Leisure’ı satın aldı - Son Haberler - Milliyet |url=https://www.milliyet.com.tr/ekonomi/arcelik-ingiliz-markasi-leisure-i-satin-aldi-5209980 |access-date=2023-08-14 |website=www.milliyet.com.tr}} In 2004, Arçelik acquired German TV and home appliance maker [[Grundig]] in a partnership with [[Alba (brand)|Alba plc]]. In 2007, Arçelik became the sole-owner of the Grundig Multimedia B.V. and its eponymous brand.{{Cite web |title=Beko, Grundig'in tamamını satın aldı - Son Dakika Haberler |url=https://www.hurriyet.com.tr/ekonomi/beko-grundigin-tamamini-satin-aldi-7889273 |access-date=2023-08-14 |website=www.hurriyet.com.tr}}{{Cite web |title=CNN.com - Turkey switches on to TV market - Jan 17, 2005 |url=http://edition.cnn.com/2005/BUSINESS/01/17/turkey.beko/ |access-date=11 April 2023 |website=CNN}} To increase brand recognition, Beko became the sponsor of [[Watford F.C.]] during the 2007-2008 and the 2008–2009 seasons. Beko has also been among the sponsors of [[FC Barcelona]] between 2014 - 2022 and [[AFC Ajax]] from 2026.{{Cite web |date=31 May 2024 |title=Beko became the global main sponsor of FC Barcelona |url=https://www.dunya.com/sirketler/beko-fc-barcelonanin-global-ana-sponsoru-oldu-haberi-403469 |access-date=15 February 2018 |website=dunya.com}}{{Cite web |title=Beko Becomes Official Confidence Partner of Ajax |url=https://www.bekoeurope.com/press-room/press-releases/beko-becomes-official-confidence-partner-of-ajax/ |archive-url=http://web.archive.org/web/20260313072431/https://www.bekoeurope.com/press-room/press-releases/beko-becomes-official-confidence-partner-of-ajax/ |archive-date=2026-03-13 |access-date=2026-07-30 |website=www.bekoeurope.com |language=en}} In 2011, Arçelik acquired South Africa’s largest appliance maker [[Defy Appliances|Defy]] from [[Franke (company)|Franke]] for $327M.{{Cite news |date=2011-07-21 |title=Arcelik to Pay $327 Million in Total for South African Defy |language=en |work=Bloomberg.com |url=https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2011-07-21/arcelik-agrees-to-acquire-appliance-maker-defy-for-327-million-ceo-says |access-date=2023-08-14}} In 2022, [[Whirlpool Corporation]] has made a strategic review on its EMEA operations due to lower EBIT margins. This resulted in a series of transactions between Arçelik and Whirlpool.{{Cite news |date=2023-01-17 |title=Whirlpool to divest most of EMEA ops, form new entity with Turkey's Arcelik |language=en |work=Reuters |url=https://www.reuters.com/markets/deals/whirlpool-divest-parts-emea-business-2023-01-17/ |access-date=2023-08-14}} # Arçelik acquired Whirlpool’s operations in the Middle East and Africa for €20M. # Arçelik acquired Whirlpool’s Turkish manufacturing plants for €78.3M. These plants have an annual production capacity of 1.3 million freezers and 1.4 million washing machines.{{Cite web |title=Arçelik, ABD'li Whirlpool'un Türkiye'deki üretim merkezini satın aldı |url=https://www.ntv.com.tr/ekonomi/arcelik-abdli-whirlpoolun-turkiyedeki-uretim-merkezini-satin-aldi,IGBvWblGb0KzxvvUxpanEQ |access-date=2023-08-14 |website=www.ntv.com.tr |language=tr}} # Arçelik acquired Whirlpool’s operations in Russia and several other Commonwealth of Independent States (CIS) countries on the wake of [[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]. Arçelik is expected to make a series of deferred payments over a 10-year period capped at €220M, based on the net asset value of the business.{{Cite news |date=2022-06-28 |title=Whirlpool to exit Russia, take $300 mln-$400 mln hit in second quarter |language=en |work=Reuters |url=https://www.reuters.com/business/whirlpool-exit-russia-take-300-mln-400-mln-hit-second-quarter-2022-06-28/ |access-date=2023-08-14}} # Arçelik and Whirlpool decided to merge their European operations under one entity [[Beko Europe]], which will be held 75% by Arçelik and 25% by Whirlpool. This new entity will have 11 plants across Italy, UK, Poland, Romania and Slovakia. [[Bauknecht (company)|Bauknecht]] and other brands are now subordinate to Beko.{{cite web | url=https://www.infoboard.de/arcelik-whirlpool-gruenes-licht-von-der-eu/ | title=Arçelik & Whirlpool: Green light from the EU | date=2023-11-23 }}{{cite web | url=https://www.bekoeurope.com/en/about-us/ | title=Brands | date=2025-12-02}}{{cite web | url=https://www.bekogermany.de/unternehmen/ | title=Unternehmen | date=2025-12-10}} '''APAC Region''' In 2015, Arçelik’s first plant in the region started production in Thailand. The plant has a production capacity of 300,000 units per year and is configured to the needs of the Southeast Asian market.{{Cite web |title=Arçelik |url=https://www.arcelikglobal.com/en/company/press-room/press-releases/thailand-factory-made-its-first-refrigerator-production/ |access-date=2023-08-14 |website=www.arcelikglobal.com |language=tr}} In 2017, Arçelik acquired Pakistan’s [[Dawlance]] for $243M.{{Cite web |title=Arçelik, Dawlance'ı 243 milyon dolara satın aldı |url=https://www.dunya.com/sirketler/arcelik-dawlancei-243-milyon-dolara-satin-aldi-haberi-336065 |access-date=2023-08-14 |website=www.dunya.com}} In 2017, Arçelik and [[Tata Group]] has announced a new partnership. Arçelik and [[Voltas]] will form a joint-venture in India named Voltbek Home Appliances Ltd. This entity will provide manufacturing, sales, and after-sales services for VoltasBeko branded home appliances (refrigerators, washing machines microwaves, etc.) in India. The partners set an ambitious target to reach $1B revenue and exceed 10% market share in the Indian market over ten years.{{Cite web |title=Arçelik |url=https://www.arcelikglobal.com/en/company/press-room/press-releases/update-on-the-joint-venture-between-voltas-and-arcelik/ |access-date=2023-08-14 |website=www.arcelikglobal.com |language=tr}} In 2019, Arçelik acquired a 57% stake in [[Singer Bangladesh]] for $75M.{{Cite web |title=Arçelik |url=https://www.arcelikglobal.com/en/company/press-room/press-releases/arcelik-to-acquire-singer-bangladesh-operations-for-75-million/ |access-date=2023-08-14 |website=www.arcelikglobal.com |language=tr}} In 2021, Arçelik and [[Hitachi|Hitachi Global Life Solutions]] has announced a new partnership. Hitachi GLS will transfer 11 subsidiaries outside Japan (two manufacturing and nine sales companies) into Arçelik Hitachi Home Appliances B.V. and sell a 60% stake in this entity to Arçelik for $343M. This entity will provide manufacturing, sales, and after-sales services for Hitachi branded home appliances (refrigerators, washing machines and vacuum cleaners, etc.) outside Japan.{{Cite web |date=2021-07-01 |title=New Joint Venture Arçelik Hitachi Home Appliances - Hitachi in Europe {{!}} Inspire the Next |url=https://www.hitachi.eu/en/press/new-joint-venture-arcelik-hitachi-home-appliances/ |access-date=2023-08-14 |website=Hitachi in Europe {{!}} Inspire the Next - |language=en}}{{Cite web |title=KAP |url=https://www.kap.org.tr/Bildirim/945379 |access-date=2023-08-14 |website=www.kap.org.tr}} In April 2026, Arçelik sold its stake in Arçelik Hitachi Home Appliances JV for $261M following [[Nojima Corporation]]’s acquisition of Hitachi’s consumer appliances unit. {{Cite web |last=Bloomberght |date=2026-04-21 |title=Arçelik'ten Hitachi'de pay satışı |url=https://www.bloomberght.com/arcelik-ten-hitachi-de-pay-satisi-3775349 |access-date=2026-04-21 |website=Bloomberght |language=tr}} {{Cite web |title=Hitachi to establish a new company with Nojima under a strategic partnership to accelerate growth of its home appliance business |url=https://www.hitachi.com/en/press/articles/2026/04/0421b/ |access-date=2026-04-21 |website=Hitachi Global |language=en}} ==Brands== * Turkey: Altus, Arçelik, [[Beko]], [[Grundig]] * EMEA Region: Altus, [[Arctic S.A.|Arctic]], [[Hotpoint Ariston|Ariston]], [[Bauknecht (company)|Bauknecht]], [[Beko]], Blomberg, [[Defy Appliances|Defy]], Elektra Bregenz, Flavel, [[Hotpoint Ariston|Hotpoint]]*, [[Grundig]], [[Indesit]], Ignis, Leisure, Polar, Privileg, [[Whirlpool Corporation|Whirlpool]]* * APAC Region: [[Beko]], [[Dawlance]], [[Singer Bangladesh|Singer]]*, [[Voltas Beko]] *Licenses limited to certain jurisdictions ==Technology and innovations== Arçelik has 17 R&D centers globally. Some of its innovative products include the first automated Turkish coffee maker Telve, the first washing machine in the industry made from recycled materials and tumble dryer with pet hair removal.{{Cite web |title=Arçelik |url=https://www.arcelikglobal.com/en/technology/rd/overview/ |access-date=2023-08-14 |website=www.arcelikglobal.com |language=tr}}{{Cite web |date=2021-12-08 |title=Beko launches new appliance range made from recycled waste |url=https://news.ifa-berlin.com/beko-new-mda-range-recycled/ |access-date=2023-08-14 |website=IFA Newsroom |language=en-US}} As of 2022, Arçelik is #67 on [[World Intellectual Property Organization|WIPO]]’s ranking for "Companies That Filed the Most International Patent Applications" and is the only entrant to the list from Turkey.{{Cite web |title=Arçelik'ten global ölçekte başarı |url=https://www.dunya.com/sektorler/arcelikten-global-olcekte-basari-haberi-690935 |access-date=2023-08-14 |website=www.dunya.com}} ==Sustainability== Source:{{Cite web |title=Arçelik |url=https://www.arcelikglobal.com/en/sustainability/awards-achievements/ |access-date=2023-08-14 |website=www.arcelikglobal.com |language=tr}} Arçelik A.Ş. was chosen among the first 15 companies to be accepted into the [[Borsa Istanbul|Borsa Istanbul Sustainability Index]] in 2014.{{Cite web |title=UN Global Compact {{!}} Borsa İstanbul, BIST 30’dan 15 Şirketin Yer Aldığı BIST Sürdürülebilirlik Endeksi’ni hesaplamaya başladı |url=https://www.globalcompactturkiye.org/borsa-istanbul-bist-30dan-15-sirketin-yer-aldigi-bist-surdurulebilirlik-endeksini-hesaplamaya-basladi/ |access-date=2023-08-14 |language=tr}} It has been accepted to the [[FTSE4Good Index|FTSE4Good Emerging Market Index]] in 2016. * [[Carbon Disclosure Project|CDP]]: Arçelik has been recognized for leadership in corporate transparency and performance on Water Security with an A score and on Climate Change with an A− score by the global environmental non-profit CDP. * [[Dow Jones Sustainability Indices|Dow Jones Sustainability Index]]: Arçelik has achieved 87/100 in the S&P Global Corporate Sustainability Assessment (CSA) as of 21 October 2022.  For the fourth consecutive year, Arçelik achieved the highest score out of 46 companies assessed in the DHP Household Durables Industry based on the results of 16 December 2022. * EcoVadis: Arçelik has obtained a score of 70/100 and has been awarded a Gold EcoVadis Medal in 2022 for this achievement. This places Arçelik in the top 2% of companies rated by EcoVadis in the manufacture of domestic appliances industry. == Gallery == File:Arcelik.svg|Old brand logo ArçelikTelve.jpg|Telve Turkish coffee machine File:ArçelikWashingMachine.jpg|Arçelik Washing Machine File:Arçelik Vacuum Cleaner.JPG|Arçelik Vacuum Cleaner File:RFE06 Arcelik.jpg|Arçelik is Turkish television maker, found in Royal Flora Expo 2006 == See also == * [[List of companies of Turkey]] ==References== {{Reflist}} ==External links== {{Commons category}} * {{Official website|https://www.arcelik.com}} {{Koç family}} {{Istanbul Stock Exchange companies}} {{Home appliance brands}} {{Authority control}} {{DEFAULTSORT:Arcelik}} [[Category:Electronics companies established in 1955]] [[Category:Manufacturing companies based in Istanbul]] [[Category:Companies listed on the Istanbul Stock Exchange]] [[Category:Companies in the BIST 100]] [[Category:Home appliance manufacturers of Turkey]] [[Category:Electronics companies of Turkey]] [[Category:Turkish brands]] [[Category:Koç family]] [[Category:Beyoğlu]] [[Category:Multinational companies headquartered in Turkey]] [[Category:1955 establishments in Turkey]] [[Category:Companies established in 1955]] [[Category:Turkish companies established in the 1950s]] [[Category:Manufacturing companies established in 1955]]

Arçelik A.Ş. (Turkish pronunciation: [aɾtʃeˈlic]) is a Turkish multinational household appliances manufacturer.
The company engages in the production, marketing and after-sale services of durable goods and their components. Its products include white goods (such as refrigerators, freezers, washing machines, dishwashers) and small home appliances (such as vacuum cleaners, coffee makers and blenders).
Arçelik A.Ş. is active in more than 100 countries, including China and the United States through its 13 international subsidiaries and over 4,500 branches in Turkey. The company operates 15 production plants in Turkey, Romania, Russia, China, South Africa and Thailand including refrigerator, washing machine, dishwasher, cooking appliances and components plants. It offers products under its own brand names, including Arçelik, Beko, Grundig, Dawlance, Altus, Blomberg, Arctic, Defy, Leisure, Arstil, Elektra Bregenz and Flavel.
The company is controlled by Koç Holding, Turkey's largest industrial and services group with USD 24.9 billion in consolidated revenues in the first half of 2023, and is the market leader in Turkey's appliance sector with its Arçelik and Beko brands. Following the merger of European activities with Whirlpool Corporation, Beko Europe became the largest household appliances company in Europe, ahead of BSH Hausgeräte and Electrolux based on production volumes.
It has been reported that as of April 2024, the company will continue its activities in the global market under the name Beko Corporate.
